definitions.explanation: Describes something complicated or requiring effort that one would rather avoid.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{煩|わずら}わしくて⟦{嫌|いや}→嫌：10232_iya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The procedures are so troublesome that I'm fed up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人間関係|にんげんかんけい}→人間関係：11462_ningenkankei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{煩|わずら}わしい⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Sometimes I find interpersonal relationships bothersome.

examples.japanese: {煩|わずら}わしい⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{答|こた}えたくない→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧。
examples.english: I don't want to answer annoying questions.

notes:
FORMS:
- Adverbial: {煩|わずら}わしく
- Noun form: {煩|わずら}わしさ

{煩|わずら}わしい describes things that are complicated, require effort, or cause mental burden. Often used for:
- Administrative procedures
- Social obligations
- Complicated relationships

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{煩|わずら}わしい (procedures are troublesome)
- {煩|わずら}わしい⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧ (avoid troublesome things)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{面倒|めんどう}→面倒：03809_mendou⟧: General trouble or bother
- {煩|わずら}わしい: More formal, emphasizes mental burden
- ⟦{鬱陶|うっとう}しい→鬱陶しい：06169_uttoushii⟧: Gloomy/oppressive annoyance

REGISTER: Slightly formal; used in both written and spoken Japanese.

forms.label: Conditional たら
forms.negative: {煩|わずら}わしくなかったら
